occurrences.summary: Exact-head repository validation had to use a local evidence-integrity fallback while GitHub Actions was recorded QUOTA_EXHAUSTED; repeated agents treated hosted runner absence as a stopping condition.

The quota-resilience repair branch itself observed all pull-request workflow runs returning action_required rather than executable proof, demonstrating that provider state cannot remain the sole proof path.
